title: How to Make a Dish Less Spicy
paragraphs: Have you ever cooked a meal and then discovered that it was far too spicy? Luckily, there are several simple ways to make a dish less hot.

The heat in chili peppers comes from a substance called capsaicin. Capsaicin does not dissolve in water, so drinking water or adding more water to a dish will not help much. In fact, cooking a dish for longer can make it even spicier, because the liquid evaporates and the heat becomes more concentrated.

One of the most effective solutions is to add dairy products, such as milk, cream or yogurt. Capsaicin dissolves in fat, and a protein in milk helps to remove it from your tongue. However, dairy may not work well in some dishes, such as tomato sauces, because it can curdle.

Another option is to add a little sugar or honey. Sugar does not remove the capsaicin, but it balances the flavor so that the heat is less noticeable. Similarly, adding something acidic, such as lemon juice or vinegar, can help to distract your taste buds.
You can also add more of the other ingredients in the dish, such as vegetables or meat, so that the spice is spread out. Serving the dish with rice or bread can also help.
Finally, to avoid the problem in the future, remove the seeds and the white parts inside chili peppers, because this is where most of the capsaicin is found.
